content.short: Blockus provides wallet-as-a-service accounts, wallet management, and fiat and crypto payments.
content.description: Blockus streamlines onboarding for Web2 and Web3 gamers within a Web2.5 gaming economy. The platform helps game studios ship features quickly, reduce costs, and keep gameplay at the center. It provides Wallet-as-a-Service accounts with wallet management, a first-party NFT marketplace, and fiat plus crypto payments, all designed to simplify monetization and player engagement while enabling developers to focus on game quality.
